item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.30)] Jabil upgraded by UBS as AI demand, healthcare growth support outlook
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.30)
UBS has upgraded Jabil (NYSE: JBL) to 'Buy' and increased its price target to $430, anticipating a multiyear growth cycle. This positive outlook is driven by robust AI investments, increasing healthcare demand, and expansion in automation and robotics markets. UBS projects Jabil's AI-related revenue to grow significantly, supported by capacity expansions and strategic shifts towards higher-margin products and faster-growing sectors.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (-0.10), NVDA Neutral (-0.06), AMZN Neutral (-0.14)] Alphabet Shares (NASDAQ:GOOGL) Slide 3.6% Ahead of Pixel 11 Debut; AI Investment Remains Central Issue
item.category: MSFT Neutral (-0.10), NVDA Neutral (-0.06), AMZN Neutral (-0.14)
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (-0.10), NVDA Neutral (-0.06), AMZN Neutral (-0.14)
Alphabet's (NASDAQ:GOOGL) stock fell 3.6% ahead of its Pixel 11 launch event, primarily due to investor focus on the company's significant AI investments and negative free cash flow, rather than the immediate impact of Pixel sales. While the Pixel 11 will showcase Gemini AI, its financial contribution is minor compared to Google's Search and Cloud divisions, with Cloud expansion and its associated $200 billion capital expenditure being the main concern for investors. Analysts remain largely positive on Alphabet, with a consensus "Buy" rating and a price target suggesting a 22.6% premium.

item.title: [MSFT Bearish (-0.22)] Alphabet Inc Class A Stock (GOOGL) Moved Down by 3.61% on Aug 11: Facts Behind the Movement
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bearish (-0.22)
Alphabet Inc Class A (GOOGL) stock fell by 3.61% on August 11, driven by broader market pressure, a sector rotation away from high-valuation tech stocks, and investor concerns over significant AI capital expenditures leading to potential margin compression. Additionally, corporate developments like leadership changes in AI and ongoing regulatory scrutiny in digital advertising contributed to the negative sentiment. Technical indicators suggest a mixed outlook, while the company maintains strong fundamental rankings in its industry.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (-0.12)] Alphabet Inc Class C Stock (GOOG) Moved Down by 3.38% on Aug 11: What Investors Need To Know
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (-0.12)
Alphabet Inc Class C (GOOG) shares dropped by 3.38% due to investor concerns over significant capital expenditures to support AI development and persistent global regulatory challenges. Despite strong core advertising and Google Cloud performance, the increased spending trajectory and ongoing antitrust issues are impacting market sentiment. Analysts maintain long-term positive outlooks but acknowledge short-term pressures from spending efficiency and regulatory overhangs.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.13)] American Integrity Insurance (AII) CEO reports 49,924-share planned stock sale
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.13)
American Integrity Insurance Group, Inc. (AII) CEO Robert C. Ritchie reported the sale of 49,924 shares of company common stock in two transactions on August 6 and August 7, 2026. These sales were executed under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted on March 12, 2026. The shares were sold at weighted average prices of $20.83 and $21.01, totaling approximately $1.04 million.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.23)] Kroger Bundles Grocery and Prescription Delivery
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.23)
Kroger has launched a new service allowing shoppers to combine eligible prescription and grocery deliveries in a single order through Instacart. This initiative aims to enhance convenience and strengthen Kroger's e-commerce capabilities, which recently saw a 19% surge in adjusted sales. The service, already launched by Harris Teeter, highlights Kroger's focus on online growth and loyalty programs, underscored by the recent hiring of Nate Faust as EVP and chief e-commerce officer.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.12)] Skyworks Solutions (SWKS) Is Up 12.2% After Major Debt Raise And Dividend Suspension Shift To Buybacks
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.12)
Skyworks Solutions (SWKS) recently completed a $2.00 billion debt raise and, simultaneously, suspended its quarterly dividend while authorizing $2.00 billion in share repurchases. This strategic shift moves the company's shareholder return focus from dividends to buybacks and aims to increase balance sheet flexibility. The company's investment narrative now centers on execution in RF technology and diversification beyond mobile, with a new emphasis on cash generation and capital allocation amidst weaker earnings.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.06)] Robotics Stocks Rally as Unitree's 8000X Oversubscribed IPO Draws Frenzied Demand: Ouster, Symbotic, and Teradyne in Focus
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.06)
Robotics stocks, including Ouster, Symbotic, and Teradyne, are rallying due to frenzied investor demand for physical AI, sparked by the 8,000x oversubscription of Chinese humanoid maker Unitree Robotics' Shanghai IPO. Ouster saw a 7% jump and Teradyne rose 3%, reflecting growing investor enthusiasm for the sector. While some companies like Teradyne and Ouster show significant year-to-date gains, Symbotic remains a laggard, suggesting its current bounce might be short-covering rather than a confirmed trend reversal.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.23)] Southwest Airlines adds two veteran executives to board of directors
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.23)
Southwest Airlines has appointed Jason Liberty, chairman and CEO of Royal Caribbean Group, and Varun Krishna, CEO of Rocket Cos., to its board of directors. These additions aim to strengthen the board with expertise in technology, digital innovation, commercial strategy, and financial leadership as the airline continues its business transformation. The new directors will help the 13-member board oversee management, enhance customer experience, and execute strategic priorities, following recent leadership changes and a board overhaul prompted by an activist investor.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.09)] Apple Pay chief Jennifer Bailey to retire in October - report
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.09)
Jennifer Bailey, the executive who has led Apple's Pay and Wallet services since 2014, will retire in October after more than 20 years with the company. Services chief Eddy Cue announced her departure in a staff memo, noting that Apple Pay, under Bailey's leadership, has revolutionized how hundreds of millions of users pay and has expanded into financial services like the Apple Card. Bailey will remain in an advisory capacity during the transition, with a succession plan to be announced soon.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (-0.10)] Apple Executive in Charge of Pay and Wallet Services Is Leaving
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (-0.10)
Jennifer Bailey, Apple's longtime head of Pay and Wallet services and Vice President of Apple Pay since its 2014 launch, is retiring in October after more than two decades with the company. Her departure was announced by Apple services chief Eddy Cue in a staff memo. This move contributes to a significant change in leadership at Apple.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.34)] IBM Lands $240 Million AI Deal with Together AI to Scale Inference
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.34)
IBM has secured a $240 million multi-year deal with Together AI to enhance its AI inference capabilities. This partnership will establish a large-scale inference cluster on IBM Cloud using NVIDIA HGX B300 systems, aiming to boost AI processing capacity for enterprises. The collaboration is expected to make the new infrastructure available in the first quarter of 2027 and has already positively impacted IBM's stock performance.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.32)] JBL Stock Jumps 6% After UBS Upgrade — How Amazon, Meta, Google Could Power Jabil’s AI Growth
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.32)
Jabil Inc. (JBL) shares rose after UBS upgraded the stock to ‘Buy,’ citing significant AI-driven growth fueled by investments from Amazon, Meta, and Google. UBS projects Jabil’s AI-related revenue to increase by 50% to $20.3 billion in fiscal 2027, with Amazon being a key AI partner. The firm maintained its $430 price target, suggesting a nearly 28% upside.

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.43)] Apple Sued Over Alleged Privacy Gaps in ‘Private Relay’ Service
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bearish (-0.43)
Apple Inc. is being sued by a California man who claims the company falsely advertised its iCloud Private Relay feature, which was supposed to hide users' IP addresses and browsing activity. The lawsuit alleges that flaws in Apple’s WebKit browser engine allowed websites to still see users’ real IP addresses, contradicting Apple's promise that no single party could see both a user's identity and their web traffic destination.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.09)] Boeing selling 3 subsidiaries to Archer Aviation, taking minority stake
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.09)
Boeing is selling three subsidiaries—Wisk Aero, Insitu, and Skygrid—to Archer Aviation in exchange for a minority stake, amounting to 19.75% of Class A shares with options to buy more. This deal, expected to close by the end of 2026, allows Boeing to focus on its core commercial and defense manufacturing while Archer expands its aerospace portfolio and integrates the acquired technologies, including Wisk's autonomous flight technology. The transaction also resolves a past lawsuit between Archer and Wisk, with both companies agreeing to collaborate further.

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.44)] Apple class action alleges Hide My Email feature does not work as advertised
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bearish (-0.44)
A class action lawsuit has been filed against Apple Inc. alleging that its "Hide My Email" privacy feature does not work as advertised. The plaintiff claims that Apple misrepresented the feature's ability to conceal users' real email addresses, despite marketing it as a core privacy component of its products and services. Security researchers reportedly discovered that the feature has a flaw allowing real email addresses to be uncovered, and Apple is accused of failing to fix this issue despite knowing about it for over a year.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.23)] ChatGPT will let you book a table mid-chat through Yelp
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.23)
OpenAI's ChatGPT now allows users in the U.S. and Canada to book restaurant reservations and join waitlists directly through Yelp Guest Manager, expanding its capabilities beyond just providing recommendations. While users can book via the chatbot, any modifications to reservations must be made within the Yelp app. This integration follows Yelp's earlier partnership with ChatGPT, which enabled the chatbot to use Yelp's reviews and business details for recommendations.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.21)] Uber's Growth Engine Expands Across Mobility, Delivery and Robotaxis
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.21)
Uber continues to demonstrate robust growth across its diversified platform, including Mobility, Delivery, and Freight, with promising expansion into autonomous vehicle partnerships. The company's strong bookings, increased engagement, and improving operating leverage are key drivers, while challenges like debt and competitive pressures are being monitored. Uber's significant cash generation also supports investments and shareholder returns through stock buybacks.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.25)] Target taps Lowe’s exec as its first-ever AI chief
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.25)
Target has appointed Chandhu Nair as its first Chief AI Officer to integrate and focus AI efforts across the company. Nair, previously from Lowe's, will work alongside Purvi Shah, the new senior VP of UX, to ensure AI advancements are coupled with human-centered design for intuitive and useful customer and employee experiences. This move highlights retailers' increasing investment in AI and the importance of combining technology with user experience.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.32)] AEHR Stock Surges As Earnings Beat Fuels Hypergrowth Bets
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.32)
Aehr Test Systems (AEHR) stock surged over 9% after reporting strong fiscal Q4 earnings, beating EPS expectations with $0.11 and achieving 33% revenue growth. The company also announced record bookings and an effective backlog of approximately $100M, leading to an aggressive fiscal 2027 revenue guidance of $130–$150M. This hypergrowth projection, driven by new silicon carbide orders for EV programs and silicon photonics demand for AI data centers, has led multiple firms to raise AEHR's price targets.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.32)] The Biggest Market Movers: Aehr Test Systems Climbs on Strong Earnings
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.32)
Aehr Test Systems (NASDAQ:AEHR) surged 6.1% in midday trading on Tuesday, extending its strong performance this summer, fueled by its AI burn-in and silicon photonics story. The company reported robust fiscal Q4 results, with revenue of $18.84 million and net income of $1.39 million, and projected fiscal 2027 revenue guidance of $130 million to $150 million, implying significant year-over-year growth. Despite its high price-to-sales ratio and insider selling, the company's strong backlog and positioning in ramping markets suggest potential upside, although its volatility reflects the dynamic nature of the optical interconnects market.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.31)] DELL is Overvalued at 21.92X P/E: Should You Still Buy the Stock?
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.31)
Dell Technologies (DELL) shares are trading at a premium with a P/E ratio of 21.92X, surpassing the Zacks Computer and Technology sector's average and several competitors. Despite this, the company is experiencing a significant boom driven by AI infrastructure demand, a broader server refresh cycle, and an expanding customer base, leading to strong revenue and earnings growth projections. Analysts give DELL a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) and a Growth Score of A, suggesting it remains a strong investment opportunity due to its strategic positioning in the AI market and diversified growth prospects.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (-0.10)] Caterpillar sales surpass $20B as generators for data centers take off
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (-0.10)
Caterpillar reported record sales and revenue of $20.5 billion in the second quarter, driven by strong demand across its construction, power and energy, and resource industries segments. A significant portion of this growth came from power generation, particularly generators for data centers, leading the company to resume production of a 10-MW medium-speed gas reciprocating engine platform. Despite concerns about AI spending longevity, Caterpillar's CEO confirmed no slowdown in customer orders, with substantial backlog extending to 2030.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.27)] Skan AI Named to 2026 Inc. 5000 List, the Most Prestigious Ranking of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.27)
Skan AI has been recognized in the top 15% of the 2026 Inc. 5000 list, which highlights America's fastest-growing private companies. The company attributes its success to its approach of providing AI solutions that understand and work within a business's actual operations, rather than just pilots. This achievement underscores Skan AI's rapid growth in the enterprise software sector and its significant impact on operational efficiency for its clients.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.31)] Should You Hold or Fold SNPS Stock After a 20% Decline in 3 Months?
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.31)
Synopsys (SNPS) shares have dropped nearly 20% in the last three months, yet the company is well-positioned for growth due to the AI infrastructure boom, its acquisition of Ansys, and a strong pipeline of recurring revenue. Despite trading at a premium valuation, the company's strategic partnerships, such as with NVIDIA, and its advancements in electronic design automation (EDA) tools, strengthen its competitive edge. Zacks Investment Research recommends accumulating SNPS stock, citing robust product portfolios, diversified offerings, and a high mix of recurring revenues.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.31)] Why Apollo Global Management (APO) Stock Is Up Today
item.description:

Apollo Global Management (APO) stock rose 4.8% today, driven by a new $2.6 billion financing agreement with Yankee Global Enterprises and continued investor interest in its role in AI infrastructure financing. The positive movement is also supported by Apollo's strong second-quarter 2026 results, which showed record earnings and assets under management reaching $1.05 trillion. Insider trading data indicates recent sales by a co-president, while institutional investors show mixed activity with significant additions and removals, and congressional members have also traded the stock.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.25)] What's Going On With Oracle Stock Tuesday?
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.25)
Oracle's stock was down almost 4% on Tuesday despite positive analyst commentary. BNP Paribas analyst Stefan Slowinski highlighted Oracle's strong position in the AI infrastructure market, attractive contract economics, and potential for free cash flow inflection starting in fiscal 2029. However, the stock's decline suggests traders are focusing on resistance levels rather than the optimistic long-term outlook.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.28)] Caterpillar and Celsius have been highlighted as Zacks Bull and Bear of the Day
item.description:

Zacks Equity Research has named Caterpillar (CAT) as its Bull of the Day due to a historic quarter, strong outlook, and surging demand from AI infrastructure buildout. Conversely, Celsius Holdings (CELH) has been designated the Bear of the Day following a disappointing quarter, missed earnings, and a self-inflicted distribution issue for its flagship brand. The article also touches upon NVIDIA (NVDA) and highlights Sandisk (SNDK) as a potential AI winner, showcasing its strong growth and pricing power.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.40)] Nvidia partners with Apollo, BlackRock, and others on $500B AI financing push
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.40)
Nvidia is partnering with major financial institutions like Apollo, BlackRock, and others to launch financing platforms aimed at mobilizing over $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure. These agreements will enable outside investors to fund data centers and other AI infrastructure based on Nvidia hardware, shifting the financial burden away from Nvidia's balance sheet. Analysts view this as a positive move, reinforcing Nvidia's market position and facilitating the treatment of compute as an investable asset class.

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.45), MSFT Neutral (+0.10), AMZN Bullish (+0.40)] Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) vs. Apple Inc. (AAPL): Hedge Funds Favor One over the Other
item.category: AAPL Bearish (-0.45), MSFT Neutral (+0.10), AMZN Bullish (+0.40)
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bearish (-0.45), MSFT Neutral (+0.10), AMZN Bullish (+0.40)
Hedge funds show a preference for Amazon (AMZN) over Apple (AAPL), despite both tech giants beating revenue estimates. Amazon's stock surged due to strong AWS growth driven by AI spending, while Apple's fell after weak guidance, memory shortages, and CEO Tim Cook's final earnings call. The article suggests investors rewarded Amazon's growth and punished Apple's short-term challenges, with Amazon also having more than double Apple's hedge fund following.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.33)] ARLO Q2 Deep Dive: Subscription Growth and Product Mix Offset Margin Pressures
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.33)
Arlo Technologies (NYSE: ARLO) reported strong Q2 CY2026 results, surpassing revenue and EPS expectations due to robust subscription growth and improved product mix. The company's focus on recurring revenue streams, strategic partnerships, and upcoming product innovations like Arlo Secure 7 are expected to drive future growth despite existing margin pressures from product sales. Management's guidance for Q3 CY2026 also exceeded analyst estimates, highlighting confidence in continued momentum.

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.24), AMZN Bearish (-0.21)] Almost all top US companies, including Starbucks, Alphabet, had board diversity rules. Now most are gone
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bearish (-0.24), AMZN Bearish (-0.21)
A new analysis by ESGAUGE reveals that 61 S&P 100 companies, including Apple, Alphabet, Amazon, Starbucks, and Wells Fargo, have eliminated explicit diversity criteria for future board members since 2023. This widespread rollback signals a significant retreat from diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) initiatives in corporate boardrooms. The shift has also affected CEO succession planning, with many companies removing diversity language from their criteria, while some, like Microsoft, still maintain such commitments.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.12)] PepsiCo expands into refrigerated foods
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (+0.12)
PepsiCo is entering the refrigerated foods market in the U.S. with its Alvalle ready-to-eat gazpacho, a Mediterranean-inspired soup. This move aligns with consumer demand for foods made from recognizable ingredients. The product is now available at Whole Foods Market stores nationwide.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.07), AMZN Neutral (+0.01)] Oracle's AI Infrastructure Surge: Smart Growth Bet or a Costlier Trap?
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.07), AMZN Neutral (+0.01)
Oracle is significantly expanding its AI-driven cloud infrastructure, investing heavily in data centers and raising substantial debt to meet surging AI demand. While this strategy has led to rapid cloud revenue growth and a large increase in remaining performance obligations, it also results in negative free cash flow. Investors are evaluating whether these investments will translate into sustainable earnings growth or strain Oracle's balance sheet, particularly in comparison to competitors like Microsoft and Amazon which are also increasing AI infrastructure spending.

item.title: [MSFT Bearish (-0.44)] The Gross Law Firm Reminds Microsoft Corporation Investors of the Pending Class Action Lawsuit With a Lead Plaintiff Deadline of August 11, 2026 - MSFT
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bearish (-0.44)
The Gross Law Firm has issued a notice to Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT) shareholders regarding a pending class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Microsoft made false and misleading statements concerning its Copilot products and AI model performance, leading to a failure in converting Microsoft 365 users to paid Copilot subscriptions. Shareholders who purchased MSFT shares between May 1, 2025, and January 28, 2026, are encouraged to contact the firm to discuss lead plaintiff appointment, with a deadline of August 11, 2026.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.35)] ASML Holding NV Stock (ASML) Opened Up by 3.14% on Aug 11: Facts Behind the Movement
item.description:

The company's management has raised full-year revenue targets and is expanding lithography manufacturing capacity to address backlogs. Analysts have maintained bullish price targets, underscoring ASML's critical role in advanced chip production despite geopolitical concerns.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.31)] Buy and Hold These 2 Top-Ranked AI-Led Semiconductor Equipment Stocks
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.31)
The global semiconductor manufacturing equipment and materials industry is projected for significant growth, driven by AI-related capital expenditure. This article highlights two top-ranked semiconductor equipment stocks, Lam Research Corp. (LRCX) and Amkor Technology Inc. (AMKR), both sporting a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy). Both companies are benefiting from increasing demand in AI infrastructure, advanced packaging, and strong financial performance, making them attractive long-term investments.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.12)] Making sense of the conflicting 20th anniversary iPhone reports
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.12)
Recent reports regarding Apple's 20th anniversary iPhone are conflicting, with one analyst suggesting the "all-glass" vision has been halted due to low yield, while a Bloomberg reporter indicates the plan is still on track. The article discusses Apple's long-term vision of a "single slab of glass" iPhone, potentially incorporating under-display Face ID and cameras. It suggests that next year's iPhone design will be a significant step forward, likely impacting the iPhone Pro models, and questions whether special branding will be used for the anniversary.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.05)] Apple, Amazon and other corporate giants quietly scrap board diversity rules
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.05)
Many major U.S. companies, including Apple, Amazon, and Starbucks, have quietly removed explicit diversity criteria for their board members and, in some cases, for CEO succession. This retreat from diversity, equity, and inclusion policies accelerated in the past year, with 61 S&P 100 companies dumping such criteria since 2023. While some companies like Microsoft still maintain diversity commitments, the shift reflects a broader trend influenced by conservative activism and an increased preference for former CEOs in board positions, who are predominantly White men.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.11), MSFT Neutral (+0.12), AMZN Neutral (+0.15)] Wearable Devices Receives U.S. Patent Grant for Biometric
item.category: AAPL Neutral (+0.11), MSFT Neutral (+0.12), AMZN Neutral (+0.15)
item.description:

This patent strengthens the company's intellectual property by covering technologies that authenticate users based on combined gesture and unique biological signals, enabling secure payments and authorized actions. The technology is expected to become a key feature in future wearables, positioning Wearable Devices at the forefront of human-computer interaction.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (-0.06)] FY2027 EPS Estimates for Linde Boosted by Erste Group Bank
item.description:

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.30), NVDA Bullish (+0.40)] Nvidia unveils first open-source AI model since CEO Jensen Huang entered the chat
item.description:

This move follows CEO Jensen Huang's recent vocal support for open-source AI, believing it will boost hardware sales as models still require GPUs. The new model is free for companies to use and modify, aligning with Huang's view that open models enhance competition, lower prices, and strengthen safety and innovation.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.47)] Nvidia's $500 Billion AI Plan Gets Wall Street Backing
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.47)
Nvidia is reportedly in discussions with major Wall Street firms, including Goldman Sachs and BlackRock, to finance the next phase of AI infrastructure development, potentially freeing up over $500 billion.
